node.question: Is a frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
node.criteria: For R1, use s1, s2, and s3 in saved order, without treating dependent observations as independent corroboration. Complete when s1 identifies a frog candidate, s2 establishes added requested placement, and s3 establishes that a frog is inside the bowl, with no unresolved contradiction about that placement. Partial when s2 establishes visible requested progress and s3 establishes incomplete interior placement rather than completed placement. Absent when s2 establishes no requested progress and the other observations do not contradict that finding. Frogs solely on unrelated surfaces do not establish partial progress, and additional frogs do not downgrade a completed bowl placement. Unknown when necessary evidence remains unresolved or observations materially conflict. A support pass alone never earns completion credit.
